info.syllabusName: Multimedia Production Project_Dự án sản xuất sản phẩm TTĐPT
info.prerequisite: MED201 and VDP201 and (SDP201 or ADP201)
info.description:
This course will describe five primary stages in multimedia project, determine the scope of a multimedia project. They may include phrases, tasks, cost, timeline, elements of a multimedia project proposal. In addition, this course gives students opportunities to practice in a real-life project.

Lecturer will use several teaching methods such as conducting group discussion and sharing field work experiences in the market on top of regular teaching. Students will have the chance to present their work as well as their thinking process related to this firm..
info.studentTasks:
- Attend more than 80% of hours class in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Read the textbook in advance

- Access the course website (www.cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information, course material, online supports from teachers and other students and for pratices and assessments.

clos.loDetails: Describe the five primary stages in a multimedia project
Examine the intangible elements needed to make good multimedia production
Recognise the typical members of a multimedia project team and describe the skills that they need for their work
Understand common hardware and software tools most often used in making multimedia and choose (an) appropriate platform(s) for a project
Determine the scope of a multimedia project
Learn to schedule phases, tasks, and work items required to complete a project
Analyse the cost, timeline, and tasks required to complete a project
Recognise creative strategy, target audience, budget

assessments.gradingGuide:
Option1:

Weight: 50%

Including: Presentation (20%) + Report (30%)

Task Description:

The assessment, including one group report and one group presentation, provides you with an opportunity to understand your product and production process by experiencing in "real - life" product.

As part of production process such as director, producer, marketer, etc. this project help you to come up with some ideas and research regarding cost, timeline, target audience in different product. Moreover, you should give audiences visual content and pick the media channels you may use to reach your target audiences. Students will work in group of 3 or 4 in order to conduct this project

Presentation:

For the 30-minute presentation, you are required to showcase all of your key points mentioned in your report in front of your classmates to help them gain insights into various role in the production process, and all challenges you have to face in the past regrading your role. Your presentation should showcase your plan (including timeline of the production, estimate billing rates, how to reach the target audiences, etc.) to spread the right message using the right media platforms.

Report:

Title of the report

Introduction: group project you choose during 10 weeks and provide a justification for your choice of the types of product (Web, TVC, Film, etc.)

In the report, you have to give audiences 5 stages of the production process: Ideas, pre - production, production, post - production, distribution.

Observation and interactions: explain each stages and how/where you have researched

Reflection: Reflect on your experience of interacting between you and your teammates as well as you production and audiences. Discuss what you have learned from this project

Notes:

The detailed marking criteria for this assessment will be provided to you by your lecturer.

Option 2:(For Constructivism Approach only): Follow lecturer's proposal

assessments.gradingGuide:
Option1:

Type: Essay

Weight: 30%

Including: Presentation (10%) + Essay (20%)

Task Description:

This assessment provides you with an opportunity to reflect on your role. You are required to describe your role in the production process as an "insider". You are required to reflect on timeline, your role, how you deal with your teammate and research. This assessment provides you with an opportunity to identify each role in the production process, which role and characteristic you belong to

Presentation:

For the 10-minute presentation, you are required to showcase all of your key points mentioned in your essay in front of your classmates to help them gain insights into your role(s), how you communicate with your teammate, how you plan your work(s), advantages and disadvantages when you work in your role(s), how you understand the production process

Essay:

Your reflective essay conveys who you are as a member in the production process. Reflecting on your own role will greatly help you understand you and your teammate as well as the process in making product in multimedia industry.

Include the following sections in your reflective essay:

- Title of your essay

- Brief description of your product with which you identify, including your role, your teammates' role, timeline to finish your tasks

- Reflect what you have learn and identify as member of your group, how this role shapes your thinking and doing

Notes: The detailed marking criteria for this assessment will be provided to you by your lecturer.
